capabilities: Copy notes or folders to another vault with referenced local attachments
Update wiki and Markdown links between copied files
Drag and drop notes or folders between vault windows
Repair pasted LaTeX delimiters and HTML tables into Markdown
Copy absolute file or folder paths from the context menu
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Renamed from VaultBridge Toolkit in 0.2.3 (plugin ID unchanged); the README warns against an unrelated community plugin named "Vault Bridge" and against enabling both old and new copies. Desktop only, Obsidian 1.7.2+, macOS testing outstanding; local processing with no account, API key, or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no way to copy notes to a different vault while collecting their local attachments and keeping links between copied files working.

relations.evidence: Linked Excalidraw drawings (.excalidraw and .excalidraw.md) are included automatically

summary: Cross-vault copier that moves notes and folders to another vault with their attachments, updates copied links, and repairs pasted math and tables.
